classificationReason: The Electron main process starts and the Gateway bootstrap runs, but no BrowserWindow is ever created. 411 of 413 failures are the identical TimeoutError at tests/e2e/fixtures/electron.ts:468 (electronApplication.firstWindow). The app's own stderr shows EPERM / access-denied (0x5) failures creating its user-data directories and logger directory.

rootCauseEvidence.observed: Failed to initialize logger: Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, mkdir '<profile>\logs'
rootCauseEvidence.note: Reproduced with profile roots on D:\tmp, under the repository, and under %APPDATA%.

rootCauseEvidence.observed: Failed to create network context data directory <profile>\Network: access denied (0x5)
A standalone Electron app with no ClawX code (D:\tmp\min-electron) fails the same way: EPERM opening a report file and access-denied creating Code Cache / Network directories.
rootCauseEvidence.note: This isolates the failure from the candidate and from ClawX source entirely.

notClaimed: No E2E product behavior was verified for this candidate.
This run is not counted as a pass and does not establish product regression parity.
